research_question: Did completion fail because good candidates were unavailable, incorrectly ranked, not retained, or not transmitted to productive descendants?

include: candidate materialized in the same arm and decision before selection
exclude: model proposals forbidden by the frozen arm operator
candidate_set.selection_identifiable: at least two distinct legal non-incumbent candidates at the same decision

metrics.availability_gap: max(score of incumbent and legal same-decision candidates)-incumbent_score
metrics.selection_regret: best legal non-incumbent score-chosen non-incumbent score; only identifiable multi-candidate decisions
metrics.transmission: a retained candidate with a later generation becomes a parent; productive iff a later strict improvement is generated while it remains incumbent

claim_ceiling: historical routing evidence only; no causal mechanism, operator effectiveness, generalization, fresh-cohort use, admission, or model experiment authorization
